projects.name: Idea Labs Explorer
projects.tagline: A single-file interactive dashboard that turns 242 screenshots into a searchable, cross-linked intelligence hub.
projects.description: Offline-capable explorer built from the idea labs image drop. Pipeline: every image OCR'd with Tesseract, compressed to embedded base64 thumbnails, then analyst-verified. Frontend is one self-contained HTML file (no dependencies): tabbed interface with global search across names, URLs, prompts, and transcriptions; sortable/filterable card grid of 314 unique websites with outbound links; 9 copy-to-clipboard script/prompt packs; 136 summary cards where each card shows its screenshot, the items listed in it (hyperlinked), and a written-out transcription. Unified sitewide card design system; covers 242/242 images.
projects.stack: Python 3, Pillow, Tesseract OCR, Vanilla JavaScript, Inline CSS, JSON, Single-file HTML
projects.differentiator: Zero-dependency single-file app that works inside network-isolated sandboxes; every image is both OCR-transcribed and human-analyst verified; reverse index links each website to the exact screenshots it appeared in, and each image back to the items it lists — no other view of this archive exists.

projects.name: LoopAgent
projects.tagline: Autonomous 7-part multi-agent loop harness with independent rubric evaluation and self-improving memory.
projects.description: LoopAgent replaces static prompt engineering with a deterministic 7-part autonomous loop harness. Features persistent standards (CLAUDE.md), a 3-agent team (Strategist, Writer, Designer), an independent rubric-based Checker with a strict 95/100 pass bar, continuous memory (MEMORY.md) that converts evaluation deductions into immutable anti-pattern rules, and unattended cloud routines for headless execution.
projects.stack: Python, FastAPI, Uvicorn, Vanilla JS, CSS3, SSE Streaming, JSON Storage
projects.differentiator: Closed-loop autonomous self-correction with an independent auditor that never marks its own homework, strict 95/100 exit bar, and automated permanent memory rule distillation.
